contents.reason: The recorded reason was false and is replaced. It claimed "no quaternion-algebra page or dependency exists in the current library spine"; in fact def-quaternions and thm-quaternions-form-a-division-ring are published on rings-subrings-and-integral-domains (order 46), which IS inside this page's requires closure. The decline stands on a different and checked ground: this page builds the tensor product of MODULES over a commutative ring, and the isomorphism H (x)_R H = Mat_4(R) is a statement about the tensor product of R-ALGEBRAS — it needs the algebra multiplication on a tensor product, which no item on this page or in its closure constructs, and H is not commutative so it is not even an R-algebra of the kind this page's scalars range over.
